content: Plan: add scripts/audit.sh + a Makefile 'audit' target + a README 'Auditing the claim' section. The script builds forge from source then runs A (faithful binary_search -> L3), B (inject return Some(mid+1) -> REFUSED, postcondition not satisfied), D (third-party verus directly on the emitted golden, forge excluded -> 2 verified 0 errors), with PASS/FAIL verdicts + a non-zero exit on any failure. Verified end-to-end: make audit -> AUDIT PASSED, exit 0.
